factor_semantics: Nominal uniform linear factors estimated by rounding measured vanilla-to-Dalls geometry fits to 0.01. Not recovered author settings; not byte-exact Dalls reproduction. Custom entries explicitly marked user_defined_custom use user-selected factors relative to the exact installed mesh, not a vanilla-to-Dalls fit.
resource_key_policy: basename only; ASCII lowercase; .msh extension retained; exact match; no prefix or family fallback

application.scale_xyz: Use the same uniform_scale on X, Y and Z
application.normal_rule: Positive uniform scaling preserves normal/tangent direction. Do not multiply direction vectors by the scale.
application.application_count: once per fresh reference vertex buffer; recompute from original positions rather than multiply current positions each frame
application.scope: Mesh geometry only. MMH hierarchy offsets, bounds, PHY collision data, skeletons and attachment transforms require separate integration; they must not be guessed from this table.
